description: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of Average Lagging (AL), ranging from 2 to 8, for four different methods: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL)”, uses a linear scale with tick marks at integer intervals from 2 to 8. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU”, uses a linear scale ranging from 20 to 30, with tick marks at integer intervals. The “Consistency-CE” method is represented by a light purple line with circular markers that starts at a BLEU score of approximately 20.0 when AL is 2 and rises to about 27.0 when AL is 8. The “Inconsistency-CE” method is shown as a dark purple line with square markers, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 22.0 when AL is 2 and increasing to about 29.5 when AL is 8. The “Inconsistency-CE-MP” method is depicted by a blue line with square markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 22.0 when AL is 2 and rising to about 29.5 when AL is 8. The “Consistency-Bi” method is represented by a red line with star markers, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 24.5 when AL is 2 and increasing to about 30.0 when AL is 8.
